pool.b.vorstand_stadionausbau_gruss: Good day, I come to you today with a plan that will shape the club.
Good day, the president here, and it is about the future of our stadium.
pool.b.vorstand_stadionausbau_lage: The board wants to expand the stadium, and the plans are already on the table.
A bigger stadium is settled in the board, the only open question is how we pay for it.
pool.b.vorstand_stadionausbau_lage.hitzi: We are expanding, and soon! Now I want to know whether you stand behind it or in the way!
I will not tolerate delays on the expansion, so tell me clearly what you think of it!
pool.b.vorstand_stadionausbau_lage.loyal: You know the club and its stands like hardly anyone else, so I want your advice on the expansion.
We have achieved a lot together, and I do not want to take this step without you.
pool.b.vorstand_stadionausbau_lage.ehrge: A bigger stadium means bigger goals, and I want to see whether the squad can carry that.
With more seats the demands rise. This is the chance to lift the club a level higher.
pool.b.vorstand_stadionausbau_lage.wechs: Buildings last decades, coaches often only years, so I ask openly whether you think long term.
An expansion ties the club for the long run, and I want to know whether you will walk this path.
pool.b.vorstand_stadionausbau_lage.sensi: I know building costs can weigh heavily on the squad, so I raise it early and openly.
It matters to me that you do not feel bypassed in this project.
pool.b.vorstand_sparrunde_gruss: Good day, I have to visit you today with an unpleasant topic.
Good day, the president here, and it is about money, sadly not the good kind.
pool.b.vorstand_sparrunde_lage: The club's finances are tight, and the board sees no way around savings.
The club spends more than it earns, and the board demands that this changes.
pool.b.vorstand_sparrunde_lage.hitzig: Savings will be made, and immediately! Whoever thinks that is exaggerated has not seen the figures!
I want no excuses but savings, and in this very round!
pool.b.vorstand_sparrunde_lage.loyal: I ask you, as someone who loves the club, to accompany us through this hard time.
You have always stood by the club, and I hope you will do so now.
pool.b.vorstand_sparrunde_lage.ehrgeizig: I know you aim high, but without healthy finances every plan stays on paper.
Saving is not a renunciation of ambition but its precondition, and you must support that.
pool.b.vorstand_sparrunde_lage.wechselfr: I want to know openly whether you will stay even with tight means, since other clubs lure with more money.
Whoever wants to leave when things get tight should say so now so that we can plan.
pool.b.vorstand_sparrunde_lage.sensibel: I am aware that saving in the squad affects people, and that is why I raise it carefully.
I want you not to take the decision as distrust but as a necessity.
pool.b.vorstand_sponsor_druck_gruss: Good day, I have just come from a conversation that I did not quite like.
Good day, the president here, and I carry a message from our most important backer.
pool.b.vorstand_sponsor_druck_lage: A sponsor presses for more presence and better results, and the board passes that pressure on to you.
Our backer is unhappy with the team's showing and holds the board responsible.
pool.b.vorstand_sponsor_druck_lage.hitzi: The sponsor threatens consequences, and I do not want us to look foolish because of it!
I will not let any backer take the stage from me, so deliver results, if you please!
pool.b.vorstand_sponsor_druck_lage.loyal: I stand in front of you, but I need something to show the backer.
You have always served the club, and I want to protect you from this pressure as far as I can.
pool.b.vorstand_sponsor_druck_lage.ehrge: A satisfied sponsor is the ticket to higher spheres, and we should not squander that chance.
If we convince the backer, doors open that were closed for a long time.
pool.b.vorstand_sponsor_druck_lage.wechs: Backers come and go, and I wonder whether you want to join this race at all.
I want to know openly whether you will support a sponsor's demands in the long term.
pool.b.vorstand_sponsor_druck_lage.sensi: I know pressure from outside is unpleasant, and I do not want to pass it on to you unfiltered.
It is far from me to burden you, but the backer is waiting for an answer.
pool.b.vorstand_fanproteste_gruss: Good day, I come straight from the stands, and the mood there is anything but good.
Good day, the president here, and I have called a meeting that neither of us wanted.
pool.b.vorstand_fanproteste_lage: The fans are protesting openly against the state of the club, and the board demands an answer from you.
There is whistling in the stands and banners have appeared. The board expects you to take a position.
pool.b.vorstand_fanproteste_lage.hitzig: Those whistles are a disgrace, and I want to know what you are doing about it, on the spot!
I will not let the terraces make a fool of the club, so tell me how you will end this!
pool.b.vorstand_fanproteste_lage.loyal: I know the club is close to your heart, and that is exactly why I need your answer to the fans.
The supporters are disappointed, but I believe that if anyone can talk to them, you can.
pool.b.vorstand_fanproteste_lage.ehrgeiz: If we win the fans back, they will carry us upward again, and for that we must act now.
The protest is also a chance to show that we want more than what is currently on display.
pool.b.vorstand_fanproteste_lage.wechsel: I wonder whether you will face this headwind or prefer to head for the exit.
Fan protests are not a pleasant place, and I want to know whether you will stay and clear things up.
pool.b.vorstand_fanproteste_lage.sensibe: I know such whistles gnaw at a person, and I do not want to run you over but listen to you.
It matters to me that you do not feel alone in this situation, even though the board needs an answer.
